edits.headline: Delhi Police remove Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site
edits.subheadline: Delhi Police named three alternative venues for protests and demonstrations in the city, All India Radio reported.
editorialBody: Delhi Police de-notified Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site and named three alternative venues, All India Radio reported.
Hurricane Simon strengthened to Category 4 off Mexico's Pacific coast, Al Jazeera reported. The storm neared Mexico with winds of 155 mph, the Associated Press reported.
